frontend/ADMIN_CANISTER_AVAILABILITY_RUN: Runbook providing step-by-step instructions for checking, starting, and verifying backend canister status when admin OTP login reports unavailability.

frontend/PHASE5_VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.m: Phase 6 verification appendix covering SEO meta tags, product URL routes, robots.txt/sitemap.xml, PWA install functionality, and logout/auto-logout behavior.
